passages.provision_quote: (4) This section does not impose liability on an interactive computer service, as defined in Section 230(f)(2) of Title 47 of the United States Code.
passages.note: The duty falls on the person/committee/entity that distributes deceptive election content, not on platforms, which are expressly exempted from liability.

rows.reasoning: AB 2839 (2023-2024), authored by Pellerin, bars a person, committee, or other entity from knowingly distributing materially deceptive election content, but the law states it 'does not impose liability on an interactive computer service,' so it places no duty on platforms to remove or label content. This is the annex's 'duty on the speaker, not the platform' hard case, so the passage is adjacent to every rung and the row is BLANK.
